meta.unit: Cost figures are midpoints in thousands (k). Day estimates are per-level low–high ranges.

core.title: Core
core.description: The must-have activities in every engagement. Included in all packages.

steps.title: Understanding
steps.summary: Review client documents before asking questions.

steps.title: Stakeholder interviews
steps.summary: Map perspectives across the team to guide design decisions.

steps.title: Audit and competitors
steps.summary: Fresh look at the current product and what competitors do well.

steps.title: Goal-setting workshop
steps.summary: Agree on what the project should achieve and prioritise scope.

steps.title: Visual direction
steps.summary: Find a look that fits where the client is heading. Moodboards and key screen explorations.

steps.title: Product design
steps.summary: Key flows designed in Figma with components and prototype.

A.title: Gamification concept support
A.summary: From feedback on an existing concept to co-creating it with the client team.
levels: Feedback on the existing concept from a design perspective.
Exploration: ideas for how gamification could show up in the product, for the client team to take further.
Several concept directions explored with the client, shown in key flows.
Shaping the concept together in regular sessions, designed into key flows.
Co-creating the full concept from goals and incentive mechanics to every reward moment.

B.title: On-site / event support
B.summary: From an interview script for a client booth to running our own interviews at an event.
levels: An interview script for the client booth team.
Script, a short briefing for the booth team, and a readout.
We attend the event, meet the client team in person and run a first round of our own interviews.
A full day of our own WE3-branded interviews, plus a session comparing notes with the client team.
A few days of interviews, the script and readout for the booth team, and a joint session comparing notes.

C.title: User testing and refinement
C.summary: Testing the riskiest flows with real users before they are built.
levels: One quick round with a few users on the riskiest flow.
One round with around five users on the riskiest flows, then refinements.
Two rounds: test, refine, retest.
Two rounds across a wider set of flows.
Ongoing testing across all key flows, with refinements after each round.

D.title: Platform-native design
D.summary: Specific adjustments so the product feels at home on each platform.
levels: Necessary adjustments so the product works well on both platforms.
Small adjustments in visual style to fit each platform.
Platform-specific patterns for key interactions like navigation and sheets.
Separate designs of key flows for each platform.
A complete design for each platform.

E.title: Website extension
E.summary: Align the web presence with the new product direction.
levels: Figma components the client designers can reuse and adapt.
A single key screen to stress-test the new direction on desktop.
A few key screens across the website.
A redesign of some main parts of the website.
A redesign of the whole website, best as a follow-up project.

F.title: Motion design
F.summary: At least one signature moment designed with a motion designer.
levels: Small refinements to existing motion based on best practice.
One or two key moments, plus small refinements to what is already there.
Several key moments across the main flows.
Motion principles for the product with key moments designed.
Full motion guidelines including character animation moments.

G.title: Copywriting
G.summary: Clearer language for people who are new to the product category.
levels: A copy review of the key flows with suggestions.
Rewritten copy for the key flows.
Rewritten copy for all flows.
Key flows plus a plain-language glossary and voice guidelines.
A full voice and terminology system.

H.title: Design QA
H.summary: Reviewing what is being built against the designs.
levels: One review of the build before launch.
Reviews at key milestones.
Weekly reviews with annotated issues.
Weekly reviews plus quick answers on edge cases.
Close ongoing support while developers build.

X.title: Design partnership
X.summary: Strategy, storytelling and a brand refresh alongside the product work.
levels: A remote strategy workshop.
A multi-day strategy sprint in person.
Strategy sprint plus a storytelling workshop.
Strategy, storytelling and a rebranding workshop.
Strategy, storytelling and a full brand refresh.
